definitions: The act of multiple people or entities ganging up on or criticizing a single person or entity, often in a public or online forum.
The act of multiple people physically piling on top of one another, often in a playful or chaotic manner.
examples: The online community was dogpiling on the new user.
The kids were dogpiling on their dad in the living room.
She felt like everyone was dogpiling on her during the meeting.
